en-US.title: Whiskered: Mewgenics Scanner
en-US.subtitle: Item ID & Build Wiki Companion
en-US.description:
Point your camera at any Mewgenics item and identify it instantly with AI-powered recognition. Whiskered is the ultimate companion app for Mewgenics players.

SCAN ANY ITEM
Use your camera to scan items in real-time. Our ML model recognizes 900+ items and shows the top matches with confidence scores. Works with screenshots and photos too — crop multiple items from inventory shots for batch identification.

SEARCH EVERY DETAIL
Find any item, ability, set, class, or status effect instantly. Search across the entire Mewgenics database with one unified search bar.

EXPLORE ITEM BUILDS
Dive deep into item details — see tier ratings (S through D), set bonuses, status effects, and related items. Discover synergies and plan your perfect build.

COMPLETE GAME DATABASE
• 900+ items with descriptions, slots, rarities, and tier rankings
• All classes with stats, archetypes, and recommended sets
• Every ability organized by class and tier
• Full set listings with item breakdowns
• Status effects with item and set cross-references

BUILT FOR PLAYERS
• Works offline — no internet required for database browsing
• Dark mode support
• Fast and lightweight
• Privacy-first — no accounts, no cloud sync

Whether you're a theorycrafter optimizing builds or a new player learning the ropes, Whiskered puts the entire Mewgenics wiki in your pocket.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release! Scan Mewgenics items with your camera, search the full game database, and explore item builds, sets, abilities, and status effects.
en-US.promoText: Scan any Mewgenics item with your camera and get instant AI-powered matches. Browse 900+ items, sets, abilities & status effects. Your ultimate game companion awaits!
